# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to present 23 The Green to the Navan property market. This four-bedroom (or three-bedroom plus office) home is ideally located in the highly sought-after Bakers Hall estate. Upon entering, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hall leading to a bright and airy living room overlooking the front of the property.

## Fakta
- Typ: semi-detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 129 m²
- Energetická náročnost: A
- Lokalita: 23 The Green, Baker Hall, Navan
- Cena: 425 000 €
